raw.details:
Agnitia 2026 – 36-Hour National-Level Hackathon

Overview:

  • AGNITIA 2026 is a national-level 36-hour hackathon organized by the Prestige Institute of Engineering Management and Research (PIEMR), Indore.
  • AGNITIA brings together passionate student innovators, developers, designers, and problem-solvers from across India to transform ideas into impactful technology-driven solutions.
  • Participants will get the opportunity to explore real-world challenges, collaborate within teams, build innovative solutions, and showcase their technical and problem-solving capabilities.

Tracks:

1. CIPHER — Cybersecurity & Digital Trust

  • Building safer digital systems, protecting data, and making AI and autonomous technologies more trustworthy.

2. APEX — Autonomous Intelligence & AI Agents

  • Creating AI systems that can think, make decisions, learn, and perform tasks on their own.

3. PRAGATI — Technology for National Transformation

  • Using technology to solve real-world problems and create meaningful impact across India.

4. TERRA — Planet, Climate & Resilience

  • Using technology to tackle climate change, manage resources, and prepare for environmental challenges.

5. ODYSSEY — Open Innovation

  • An open platform to explore bold ideas and build creative, unconventional solutions to real-world problems of your choice.

Note:

  • Participants are free to propose their own innovative ideas within their selected track during Round 1.
  • The final Round 2 problem statements will be provided to shortlisted teams after Round 1.

Prize Pool:

  • ₹1,25,000
 

General Queries & Support: Join our official WhatsApp group for queries, updates, and assistance regarding AGNITIA 2026 — Join WhatsApp Group

Hackathon Structure:

Round 1 – Idea/PPT Submission

  • 10 September – 25 September 2026
  • The first round is an online idea submission and screening round.
  • Teams will select a track of their interest and propose an innovative solution based on that track.
  • Participants will submit their idea/PPT through Unstop.
  • Submissions will be evaluated based on innovation, relevance, feasibility, technical approach, and overall potential.
  • The best submissions will be shortlisted for the 36-hour hackathon.
  • No fixed problem statements will be provided in Round 1. Participants are free to develop their ideas within their selected track.

Round 2 – 36-Hour Hackathon

  • 8–10 October 2026
  • Shortlisted teams will advance to the offline 36-hour hackathon at PIEMR, Indore.
  • Selected teams will receive the official Round 2 problem statements after the completion of Round 1.
  • Teams will develop, test, and refine their solutions during the 36-hour development sprint.
  • Participants will have opportunities to interact with mentors and receive guidance throughout the hackathon.
  • Teams will finally demonstrate and present their solutions before the judging panel.
  • Winners will be selected based on the official judging criteria announced by the organizers.

Team Size:

  • Each team must consist of 2–4 members.
  • Participants are required to register and participate as a team.
  • Teams must comply with all official registration, submission, and participation guidelines.

Eligibility:

  • Open to college/university students across India.
  • Inter-college teams are allowed.
  • All team members must satisfy the eligibility requirements specified by the organizers.
  • Participants must carry a valid college/university identity card for verification during the offline round.
  • By registering, participants agree to abide by the official rules, code of conduct, submission guidelines, and decisions of the organizing committee.

What to Expect:

  • 36 hours of intensive innovation, development, and problem-solving
  • Opportunity to build technology-driven solutions
  • 5 diverse tracks covering cybersecurity, AI, national transformation, climate technology, and open innovation
  • Mentorship and guidance during the hackathon
  • Collaboration with student innovators from across India
  • ₹1,25,000 prize pool
  • Participation certificate for every participant
  • Recognition for outstanding teams and innovative solutions
  • Opportunity to present your solution before judges and experts

️ Food & Stay

Food and stay facilities will be provided to shortlisted teams for 8th and 9th October 2026 during the 36-hour hackathon. Travel expenses and transportation to/from the venue will not be provided by the organizers and must be arranged by the participants.

Important Dates:

  • Round 1 – Idea/PPT Submission: 7–25 September 2026
  • Round 1 Shortlisting: To be announced
  • Round 2 – 36-Hour Hackathon: 8–10 October 2026

Organized By:

  • Prestige Institute of Engineering Management and Research (PIEMR), Indore

Powered By:

  • Unstop
